- Horst - 32 - 40 uur - € 3.000,- / € 3.300,- per maand 
Are you an experienced MIG/MAG welder looking for a job with good conditions and a pleasant working atmosphere? Then we have the job for you in Horst. 
What do we offer? - Salary between €3,000 and €3,300 gross per month; - 25 holidays and 13 ADV days; - Working hours between 07:00 and 16:30; - A full-time job of 40 hours or 32 - A pleasant team in which you will quickly feel at home; - Room to develop yourself further and to think along with others. 
What will you do? 
As a MIG/MAG welder, you are responsible for welding products based on technical drawings. You work accurately and contribute to a safe and efficient working environment. 
No two days are the same. - Welding of products according to the MIG/MAG welding process; - Working from technical drawings; - Carrying out visual inspections and marking the weld with chalk; - Checking welded materials for quality; - Removing spatter and burr residues; - Ensuring the proper functioning of the welding equipment; - Identifying deviations and contributing ideas for improvements; - Working in accordance with the applicable environmental and safety regulations. 
What do you bring? - Experience as a welder in a production environment; - MIG/MAG level 2 or similar; - Able to read technical drawings; - Independent, but also good at working together; - Flexible attitude and no 9-to-5 mentality; - Command of the Dutch or English language.
